dedupe_keys.name: c and l band low polarization sensitive nanosecond 1 2 electro optic mzi switch on 3 m thick silicon platform

description: Wang, Yu and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The exact-title registered abstract reports fabrication and assessment of a C/L-band 1-by-2 electro-optic switch in 3-micrometre silicon. Coverage is an optical-network component test with a 6-nanosecond switching time, lowest insertion loss of 2.5 dB, averaged extinction ratio of 16 dB and polarisation-dependent loss of 2.5 dB. The native community establishes the telecom-device context. Unlike the related AWG case, the short abstract does not report transmitted bit rates or BER, so end-to-end communications performance is not inferred. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
